audit.why: HARD 8.5/10, 9.5/10 carry threat. The packet win rate is 16.67% but only 6 games; the 1193-game total and the content layer both support 'hard', so the tag stands.
Both layers already read Skill / Skill / Skill / Nautilus / Gwen / Gwen / Skill, matching the packet chart and the mirror exactly. win[N] and phases[N].side agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No chart edits — the pair is already consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'when she pops W you become untargetable to your own R, E and autos' inverts the mechanic, and the ability is written as 'Snip Snip' rather than Snip Snip!.
audit.why: Riot text: Hallowed Mist protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it — she can be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. As a melee champion you can step in and hit her; the cost is standing in her zone, not being blanked. Cooldown 22/21/20/19/18s. Skip 'n Slash is a dash that grants attack speed, range and magic on-hit, refunded partially on hit, so armour alone misreads the trade. A Thousand Cuts heals her off the damage it deals to champions, which is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decisive.
audit.corrected: mid and wants.foe[0] restated to 'you must walk into the mist'; spikes[1] and wants.foe[1] use Snip Snip!; dosFull[0].d carries the 22s; dontsFull[0].d covers on-hit and dontsFull[1].d covers anti-heal.

edits.before: Before her Snip Snip stacks and Hallowed Mist cooldown drops, your W shield lets you win extended trades if you land Q first.
edits.after: Before Snip Snip! ramps and Hallowed Mist drops to 18s, your W shield wins extended trades if you land Q first — bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Stack Snip Snip true damage that ignores your tank stats and out-scale you each item
edits.after: Stack Snip Snip! true damage that ignores your tank stats and heal off her passive

edits.before: Dodge your Q with E-dash and sit inside Hallowed Mist so your autos, R and E all miss
edits.after: Dodge your Q with Skip 'n Slash, then sit in Hallowed Mist so you must walk in to touch her

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your last real window: your W shield and E lets you win extended trades if you open with Q, and her Hallowed Mist cooldown is still long enough to punish. The instant she hits 6 it inverts — when she pops W you become untargetable to your own R, E and autos, and Needlework pokes you while you flail. Save R to catch her OUT of mist or to set up a jungle gank, never blow it into a fresh Mist.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your last real window: your W shield and E win extended trades if you open with Q, and Hallowed Mist is still 22 seconds at rank 1. The instant she hits 6 it inverts — inside the mist only enemies standing in it can touch her, so you have to walk in, and Needlework pokes you on the way. Save R to catch her OUT of mist or to set up a jungle gank, never into a fresh Mist.

edits.before: She’s safe inside. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 — she is only hittable by enemies inside it.

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash applies on-hit and attack speed — armour alone misreads it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A Thousand Cuts heals her off you — Grievous Wounds before you grind.

notes: The 'you become untargetable to your own R' line was the significant error: Hallowed Mist blocks targeting from outside the mist, so a melee Nautilus can step in. Corrected in mid and wants.foe[0]. Whether a Depth Charge already in flight is broken by a fresh Mist is not answerable from the kit files, so nothing was asserted about it — 'late' still says the CC chain does nothing, which I left alone rather than replace with a guess.
